suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require documented trastuzumab exposure for breast cancer and separately documented treatment-associated left-ventricular systolic dysfunction, cardiomyopathy, or heart failure arising after exposure. Prior or concurrent anthracycline exposure may be considered an important cardiotoxicity risk modifier/co-exposure, but PMID 18514938 should not by itself verify an anthracycline-only cardiomyopathy pathway. Do not infer cardiomyopathy from breast cancer or trastuzumab exposure alone without separately documented cardiac dysfunction. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
